what:
A five-page CFPB Closing Disclosure — the corpus's first multi-page SINGLE document. Every page restates the parties and the Loan ID, because that is what the later pages of a form are for, and every page prints 'PAGE n OF 5'. The splitter read the restatement as a document boundary and cut the form in two: page 1 extracted correctly, and the contact page came back as a near-empty second block carrying only Ficus Bank, Epsilon Title Co. and the Loan ID. The ~30 values of the Contact Information matrix were never extracted at all, because the second block was asked for the first page's slots.

Reconstructed from the published CFPB sample form. Two variants, because the over-split depends on what the page's FIRST line is: real generators differ, and both shapes must hold.
